basic_info: 35-year-old male presenting with recurrent lower respiratory infections, particularly when unloading hay on the farm.
present_illness: The patient reports recurrent lower respiratory infections occurring approximately every month or every other month, primarily when unloading hay on the farm. Symptoms include coughing, copious mucus production, shortness of breath, and low-grade fever. The patient notes that these symptoms are specifically associated with exposure to hay. The patient has not undergone any pulmonary function tests or chest imaging studies in the past.
past_history: No known history of allergies or asthma. No prior testing for allergies or asthma. No prior pulmonary function tests or chest imaging studies. No prior testing for specific IgE or IgG antibodies related to mold or other allergens commonly found in hay. No prior testing for hypersensitivity pneumonitis or other occupational lung diseases related to agricultural exposures.
